source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query: I spent all last weekend helping my next-door neighbor patch up the raised garden beds along the side of her house, and let me tell you, those old cedar planks were way more rotted out than either of us expected when we first pried the broken edges off. We ended up making a random run to the local nursery halfway through the project because she decided she wanted to tuck in a whole row of lavender and trailing strawberry plants along the front edge of the beds instead of sticking to the tomato and basil starts she’d already bought back in early spring. By the time we finished up Sunday evening, we were both covered in wood chips and potting soil, and she sent me home with a jar of the wild blackberry jam she canned last summer that’s so good I’ve been slathering it on every piece of toast I’ve made all week. I’m looking for a video surveillance camera and a little wall mount for it with 3mp resolution, I want it to have reliable motion detection so it alerts me when someone’s on my porch, it should be weatherproof for outdoor use too. Can you show me options that fit what I’m after? I don’t have a super strict budget I’m working with right now so just pull whatever makes sense for home use.

it should be weatherproof for outdoor use too
